senses.en: trying to catch or get someone or something
senses.pattern: be after sb / go after the thief / come after sb / be after a job
senses.example: The police are [[after]] a man who stole three bicycles from the school last night.
senses.example_zh: 警方正在追捕一名昨晚從學校偷走三輛腳踏車的男子。

senses.en: following the name or style of someone or something
senses.pattern: be named after sb / name A after B / model A after B
senses.example: The new library was named [[after]] a retired teacher who had donated all her savings to the school.
senses.example_zh: 新圖書館以一位把畢生積蓄捐給學校的退休教師命名。

gsat.sentence: Sullivan, while surveying a campground, felt that a cloud was coming [[after]] him, and tried all he could to run—but it got him anyway.

senses.en: to grow old; to let food or wine mature
senses.pattern: age well / age quickly / an aging population / age wine in barrels
senses.example: Doctors warn that too much sun can make your skin [[age]] much faster than it normally would.
senses.example_zh: 醫師警告，曬太多太陽會讓皮膚變老的速度比正常情況快得多。
senses.note: 現在分詞 aging／ageing 皆可

senses.en: a particular period of history
senses.pattern: the Stone Age / the digital age / the Middle Ages / the age of exploration
senses.example: In the digital [[age]], news that once took weeks to spread can reach millions within seconds.
senses.example_zh: 在數位時代，過去要花數週才能傳開的消息，幾秒內就能傳到數百萬人眼前。
senses.note: 專有名稱常大寫：the Ice Age

gsat.sentence: Why maps were important during the [[age]] of exploration.
The preference for north arose during the European [[age]] of exploration.

senses.en: to plan to have enough time or money for something
senses.pattern: allow two hours for the trip / allow extra time / allow plenty of room
senses.example: You should [[allow]] at least forty minutes to get through airport security during the holidays.
senses.example_zh: 連假期間，你應該預留至少四十分鐘通過機場安檢。

senses.en: to include something when planning or judging
senses.pattern: allow for delays / allow for inflation / allowing for traffic
senses.example: Even [[allowing]] for the bad weather, the team's performance in the final was disappointing.
senses.example_zh: 即使考慮到天氣不佳，這支隊伍在決賽的表現仍令人失望。

senses.en: to make something possible
senses.pattern: allow for flexibility / allow for more choices / allow for future growth
senses.example: The classroom's movable desks [[allow]] for many different kinds of group activities.
senses.example_zh: 教室裡可移動的課桌使多種不同的小組活動成為可能。
senses.note: 主詞多為事物、設計或制度

gsat.sentence: Installed in Detroit in 1920, Potts’ three-color system [[allowed]] for the added signal “proceed with caution” to be displayed.
They were then replaced by colorful glass beads, [[allowing]] for more detailed beadwork and color patterns.

senses.en: an idea or memory that something makes you think of
senses.pattern: have associations with sth / word association / pleasant associations
senses.example: For many people, the smell of fresh bread has happy [[associations]] with childhood mornings at home.
senses.example_zh: 對許多人來說，剛出爐麵包的香味會引起美好的聯想，讓人想起童年在家的早晨。

senses.en: a connection or link between two things
senses.pattern: an association between A and B / a close association with sth / in association with sb
senses.example: Researchers found a clear [[association]] between a lack of sleep and poor performance on memory tests.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員發現，睡眠不足與記憶測驗表現不佳之間有明顯的關聯。

gsat.sentence: Recent or repeated exposure to a song or even a small part of a song can also trigger earworms, as can word [[associations]], such as a phrase similar to the lyrics of a song.
The [[association]] of particular patterns with individual families can be traced back hundreds of years.

senses.en: the bottom of a river, lake, or sea
senses.pattern: a dry river bed / the sea bed / the bed of the lake
senses.example: After months without rain, the river [[bed]] was completely dry and covered with cracks.
senses.example_zh: 幾個月沒下雨，河床完全乾涸，布滿了裂痕。

senses.en: an area of ground for growing plants
senses.pattern: a flower bed / a vegetable bed / a rose bed
senses.example: Grandpa spent the whole afternoon planting tulips in the flower [[bed]] beside the gate.
senses.example_zh: 爺爺花了整個下午在大門旁的花圃裡種鬱金香。

senses.en: except; apart from
senses.pattern: everyone but me / nothing but / anything but / have no choice but to V
senses.example: Everyone in the class [[but]] Kevin handed in the science report on time.
senses.example_zh: 除了凱文以外，班上每個人都準時交了自然科報告。

senses.en: only; no more than
senses.pattern: be but a child / but a moment ago / to name but a few
senses.example: Life is [[but]] a short journey, so spend it with the people you love.
senses.example_zh: 人生只不過是一段短暫的旅程，所以要與你所愛的人共度。

senses.en: unfair or unkind and deserving no respect
senses.pattern: a cheap trick / a cheap shot / a cheap joke / cheap remarks
senses.example: Making fun of a classmate's accent to get a laugh is a [[cheap]] trick.
senses.example_zh: 取笑同學的口音來博取笑聲，是很卑劣的手段。

senses.en: unwilling to spend money
senses.pattern: too cheap to tip / a cheap boss / don't be so cheap
senses.example: Uncle Ray is so [[cheap]] that he reuses tea bags three or four times.
senses.example_zh: 雷叔叔非常小氣，一個茶包都要重複泡三、四次。
senses.note: 美式口語；英式多用 mean

senses.en: a group of people with the same social and economic position
senses.pattern: the middle class / the working class / social class
senses.example: In the nineteenth century, education was a luxury that only the upper [[class]] could afford.
senses.example_zh: 在十九世紀，教育是只有上層階級才負擔得起的奢侈品。

senses.en: a level of quality or service, especially in travel
senses.pattern: first class / economy class / be in a class of its own
senses.example: We could not afford business [[class]], so we sat in the back of the plane for twelve hours.
senses.example_zh: 我們負擔不起商務艙，所以在機艙後段坐了十二個小時。

gsat.sentence: The fashion soon spread beyond the circle of the nobility to the middle [[classes]], and tea became a popular drink at the London coffee houses where people met to do business and discuss events of the day.

senses.en: to report on an event for the news media
senses.pattern: cover a story / cover the election / cover the Olympics
senses.example: The newspaper sent two young reporters to [[cover]] the flood in the southern villages.
senses.example_zh: 報社派了兩名年輕記者去報導南部村莊的水災。

senses.en: to be enough money to pay for something
senses.pattern: cover the cost / cover expenses / cover the rent
senses.example: Her part-time salary barely [[covers]] the rent, so she cooks at home to save money.
senses.example_zh: 她打工的薪水只勉強足以支付房租，所以她在家煮飯省錢。

senses.en: to travel a particular distance
senses.pattern: cover a distance / cover ten kilometers / cover a lot of ground
senses.example: The hikers [[covered]] twenty kilometers on the first day before setting up camp by the river.
senses.example_zh: 登山客第一天走完二十公里後，才在河邊紮營。

gsat.sentence: Homer was assigned to [[cover]] the inauguration of President Lincoln and, later, the Civil War.
Children in this region often start running at an early age, [[covering]] great distances to fetch water and firewood or to reach the nearest school.

senses.en: to force someone or something into a state or action
senses.pattern: drive sb crazy / drive sb to do sth / be driven by / the driving force
senses.example: Hunger and the bitter cold finally [[drove]] the lost hikers to seek shelter in a cave.
senses.example_zh: 飢餓和嚴寒最後迫使迷路的登山客到洞穴裡躲避。

senses.en: energy and determination to succeed
senses.pattern: have the drive to do sth / lack drive / drive and ambition
senses.example: Talent alone is not enough; a young athlete also needs the [[drive]] to train every day.
senses.example_zh: 光有天分是不夠的；年輕運動員還需要每天訓練的幹勁。

senses.en: an organized effort by a group to achieve something
senses.pattern: a blood drive / a food drive / a fund-raising drive / a recycling drive
senses.example: Our class organized a book [[drive]] and collected five hundred books for a village library.
senses.example_zh: 我們班發起了募書活動，為一座鄉村圖書館募集了五百本書。

gsat.sentence: Trade is certainly a main [[driving]] force for globalization.
The barking of the hound, which [[drives]] deer to panic, strengthens the effect of the warning noise, according to the RTRI.

senses.en: to find out or prove that something is true
senses.pattern: establish the cause / establish the facts / establish that
senses.example: Doctors ran several tests to [[establish]] whether the infection had spread to her lungs.
senses.example_zh: 醫生做了幾項檢查，以查明感染是否已擴散到她的肺部。

senses.en: to make someone or something accepted in a position
senses.pattern: establish oneself as / establish a reputation / become established
senses.example: Her first novel [[established]] her as one of the most promising young writers in the country.
senses.example_zh: 她的第一本小說確立了她的地位，使她成為國內最有前途的年輕作家之一。

gsat.sentence: The expansion of European imperialism in the following centuries further [[established]] the “north up” practice as the standard.
He first [[established]] his reputation as an illustrator in his hometown of Boston.

senses.en: a group of related animals, plants, or languages
senses.pattern: the cat family / a language family / belong to the same family
senses.example: Lions and tigers both belong to the cat [[family]], yet their hunting habits are quite different.
senses.example_zh: 獅子和老虎都屬於貓科，但牠們的獵食習性大不相同。

gsat.sentence: Jackdaws are birds in the crow [[family]] often found in the English countryside.

senses.en: a place where a road or river divides
senses.pattern: a fork in the road / come to a fork / take the left fork
senses.example: When you reach the [[fork]] in the trail, take the left path that leads to the waterfall.
senses.example_zh: 走到步道的岔路時，請走左邊那條通往瀑布的小徑。

senses.en: (of a road or river) to divide into two parts
senses.pattern: the road forks / fork into two / fork left
senses.example: About two kilometers past the village, the river [[forks]] into two smaller streams.
senses.example_zh: 過了村莊約兩公里處，這條河分岔成兩條較小的溪流。

senses.en: benefit or advantage to someone or something
senses.pattern: do sb good / for your own good / do more harm than good / the common good
senses.example: A week of rest in the countryside will do you a lot of [[good]] after such a stressful semester.
senses.example_zh: 經過壓力這麼大的一學期，到鄉下休息一週會對你大有好處。
senses.note: for good 意為「永遠」，勿混淆

senses.en: valid; able to be used for a stated period
senses.pattern: be good for one year / good until the end of May / good for two people
senses.example: This rail pass is [[good]] for seven days and can be used on any train in the country.
senses.example_zh: 這張鐵路周遊券七天內有效，可搭乘國內任何一班火車。

senses.en: at least a stated amount; fairly large
senses.pattern: a good two hours / a good ten kilometers / a good many / a good deal of
senses.example: It took us a [[good]] three hours to reach the lake because the mountain road was so narrow.
senses.example_zh: 因為山路非常狹窄，我們足足花了三個小時才抵達湖邊。

senses.en: a pointer on a clock or watch
senses.pattern: the hour hand / the minute hand / the second hand
senses.example: The [[hands]] of the station clock had stopped at 2:46, the moment the earthquake struck.
senses.example_zh: 車站時鐘的指針停在 2 點 46 分，也就是地震發生的那一刻。

senses.en: a worker, especially one doing physical work
senses.pattern: a farm hand / a hired hand / hire extra hands / be short of hands
senses.example: During the harvest season, the orchard hires extra [[hands]] to pick the fruit before it rains.
senses.example_zh: 採收季節時，果園會多雇一些人手，趕在下雨前把水果採完。

senses.en: a round of clapping to show approval
senses.pattern: give sb a big hand / get a big hand
senses.example: Let's give our volunteers a big [[hand]] for cleaning up the beach all morning.
senses.example_zh: 志工們整個早上都在淨灘，讓我們給他們熱烈的掌聲。
senses.note: 此義只用單數：a big hand

senses.en: the highest level, number, or price reached
senses.pattern: a record high / an all-time high / hit a new high / reach a ten-year high
senses.example: Vegetable prices climbed to a ten-year [[high]] last month after two typhoons destroyed most of the crops.
senses.example_zh: 兩個颱風摧毀了大部分農作物後，菜價上個月攀上十年來的高點。
senses.note: a record high 歷史新高；反義 a record low

senses.en: a feeling of great happiness or excitement
senses.pattern: be on a high / a natural high / an emotional high
senses.example: The players were still on a [[high]] days after winning the national championship.
senses.example_zh: 贏得全國冠軍好幾天後，球員們仍然沉浸在興奮之中。

senses.en: to end or destroy something such as a plan or feeling
senses.pattern: kill a plan / kill the mood / kill sb's hopes / kill the pain
senses.example: A sudden cut in funding [[killed]] the plan to build a new swimming pool on campus.
senses.example_zh: 經費突然遭到刪減，扼殺了在校園興建新游泳池的計畫。

senses.en: to spend time doing something while waiting
senses.pattern: kill time / kill an hour / have two hours to kill
senses.example: While waiting for the dentist, I [[killed]] time by reading the magazines on the table.
senses.example_zh: 等牙醫看診時，我翻閱桌上的雜誌來消磨時間。

senses.en: to have experienced something
senses.pattern: know hunger / know poverty / have never known war
senses.example: Having grown up during the war, my grandmother has [[known]] real hunger and never wastes food.
senses.example_zh: 我的祖母在戰爭時期長大，經歷過真正的飢餓，從不浪費食物。

senses.en: to be able to recognize or tell apart
senses.pattern: know right from wrong / know A from B / would know sb anywhere
senses.example: Even very young children usually [[know]] right from wrong, though they cannot explain why.
senses.example_zh: 即使是年紀很小的孩子，通常也能分辨是非，儘管他們說不出原因。

senses.en: one part or stage of a journey or race
senses.pattern: the first leg / the final leg of a journey / the second leg of the race
senses.example: The final [[leg]] of our trip took us from Lisbon to Madrid by overnight train.
senses.example_zh: 我們旅程的最後一段是搭夜車從里斯本到馬德里。

senses.en: a piece of land used for a particular purpose
senses.pattern: a parking lot / an empty lot / a vacant lot / a used-car lot
senses.example: The city plans to turn the empty [[lot]] behind the station into a small park.
senses.example_zh: 市政府計畫把車站後面那一塊空地改建成小公園。

senses.en: a person's situation or fate in life
senses.pattern: one's lot in life / improve one's lot / be content with one's lot
senses.example: The charity has worked for decades to improve the [[lot]] of children in poor mountain villages.
senses.example_zh: 這個慈善團體數十年來致力於改善貧困山村兒童的處境。
senses.note: draw lots 抽籤（lot 指「籤」）

senses.en: fairly small in size, amount, or value
senses.pattern: a modest increase / a modest amount / a modest income / modest growth
senses.example: The company reported only a [[modest]] increase in sales, far below what investors had hoped for.
senses.example_zh: 該公司公布的銷售額只有些微的成長，遠低於投資人的期望。

senses.en: simple and plain, not expensive or showy
senses.pattern: a modest house / a modest lifestyle / a modest meal
senses.example: Despite his great wealth, the writer lived in a [[modest]] apartment with very little furniture.
senses.example_zh: 儘管非常富有，這位作家卻住在一間樸實的公寓裡，家具少之又少。

gsat.sentence: Research shows that [[modest]] amounts of exercise—even just 15 minutes a day—helps ease depression, enhance self-image, relieve stress, and much more.
The prom has changed from a [[modest]] event to a glamorous party over the years.

senses.en: an important position of authority, especially in government
senses.pattern: take office / hold office / run for office / leave office
senses.example: She decided to run for public [[office]] because she wanted to improve the schools in her town.
senses.example_zh: 她決定競選公職，因為她想改善鎮上的學校。
senses.note: in office 在任；take office 就職

gsat.sentence: Why did Prime Minister Ryu Matsumoto resign from [[office]]?
In 2011, a minister, Ryu Matsumoto, was forced to resign after only a week in [[office]], when a bad-tempered encounter with local officials was televised.

senses.en: to make someone happy or satisfied
senses.pattern: hard to please / eager to please / please everyone
senses.example: No matter how hard the chef tried, he could not [[please]] the picky customer at table five.
senses.example_zh: 不管廚師多努力，就是無法使五號桌那位挑剔的客人滿意。

senses.en: to want, like, or choose to do something
senses.pattern: as you please / do as one pleases / whatever you please
senses.example: During the summer camp, children can swim, paint, or read as they [[please]] in the afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 夏令營期間，孩子們下午想要游泳、畫畫還是看書都可以。

gsat.sentence: Those who have an inclination for crazy technological advances aren’t hard to [[please]].

senses.en: the purpose or usefulness of something
senses.pattern: there is no point in doing / see the point / the point of doing sth / what's the point
senses.example: There is no [[point]] in buying an expensive bike if you never plan to ride it.
senses.example_zh: 如果你從不打算騎，買一輛昂貴的腳踏車就沒有意義。

senses.en: the main idea, or an opinion someone puts forward
senses.pattern: make a point / get to the point / miss the point / a good point
senses.example: The speaker talked for an hour, but most listeners still missed the main [[point]] of her argument.
senses.example_zh: 講者講了一個小時，但大多數聽眾仍沒抓到她論述的要點。

senses.en: to suggest that something is true or likely
senses.pattern: point to a problem / point to the fact that / evidence points to
senses.example: All the evidence collected so far [[points]] to human activity as the main cause of the pollution.
senses.example_zh: 目前蒐集到的所有證據都顯示，人類活動是造成污染的主因。

gsat.sentence: I just don’t see the [[point]].
In fact, if it is, it may [[point]] to an injury or muscle strain.

senses.en: to express something in a particular way
senses.pattern: put it simply / put it another way / to put it mildly / as sb puts it
senses.example: Let me [[put]] it another way: without clean water, no city can survive for long.
senses.example_zh: 讓我換個方式說：沒有乾淨的水，任何城市都無法長久存續。

senses.en: to estimate something to be a certain amount
senses.pattern: put the cost at / put the number at / put the damage at
senses.example: Experts [[put]] the cost of repairing the ancient bridge at more than two million dollars.
senses.example_zh: 專家估計修復這座古橋的費用超過兩百萬美元。
senses.note: 句型：put + 受詞 + at + 數量

gsat.sentence: As one swapper [[puts]] it, “Nobody is going to fly across the ocean or drive 600 miles to come steal your TV.

senses.en: to contact someone, especially by phone or email
senses.pattern: reach sb by phone / reach sb at this number / can't reach sb
senses.example: If you need help after school hours, you can [[reach]] me at this number.
senses.example_zh: 如果放學後需要幫忙，你可以撥這個號碼聯絡上我。

senses.en: the distance within which something can be touched or achieved
senses.pattern: within reach / out of reach / beyond the reach of sb / within easy reach of sth
senses.example: Keep all medicines out of the [[reach]] of young children, preferably in a locked cabinet.
senses.example_zh: 所有藥品都要放在幼童伸手可及的範圍之外，最好鎖在櫃子裡。

senses.en: to arrive at an agreement or decision after discussion
senses.pattern: reach an agreement / reach a conclusion / reach a decision / reach a compromise
senses.example: After three days of talks, the two companies finally [[reached]] an agreement on prices.
senses.example_zh: 經過三天的會談，兩家公司終於就價格達成協議。

gsat.sentence: And being a tiny country, everything in Rwanda is within [[reach]] in a few hours and the interesting spots can be explored comfortably in a couple of weeks.
After hours of discussion, our class finally [[reached]] the conclusion that we would go to Hualien for our graduation trip.

senses.en: (of a sign or text) to have certain words
senses.pattern: the sign reads / the note read / the headline reads
senses.example: A small sign on the gate [[read]] "Beware of the dog," so we waited outside.
senses.example_zh: 大門上有個小牌子寫著「內有惡犬」，所以我們在外面等。
senses.note: 主詞是文字、告示，不是人

senses.en: (of an instrument) to show a particular measurement
senses.pattern: the thermometer reads / the meter reads / the scale reads / the clock read
senses.example: When the thermometer [[reads]] above thirty-eight degrees, the school cancels all outdoor activities.
senses.example_zh: 溫度計顯示超過三十八度時，學校會取消所有戶外活動。

senses.en: to interpret something in a particular way
senses.pattern: read sb's mind / read sb's face / read the situation / read sth as
senses.example: I [[read]] her long silence as a sign that she did not agree with our plan.
senses.example_zh: 我把她長時間的沉默解讀為不贊同我們計畫的表示。

senses.en: the process of becoming more important, powerful, or popular
senses.pattern: the rise of / the rise and fall of / a rise to power / a rise to fame
senses.example: The [[rise]] of online shopping has forced many small bookstores in the neighborhood to close.
senses.example_zh: 網路購物的興起迫使附近許多小書店關門。

senses.en: to fight against a ruler or government
senses.pattern: rise up against / rise against / rise in revolt
senses.example: In 1789, the hungry people of Paris [[rose]] against the king and changed French history forever.
senses.example_zh: 1789 年，飢餓的巴黎人民起義反抗國王，永遠改變了法國歷史。

gsat.sentence: Paintings with white-toothed smiles emerged after the 1700s, with the gradual [[rise]] of a culture that valued perception and responsiveness.
Such demand increased with the [[rise]] of western movies, and many cowboys with masterful skills on horseback found a new career as a stunt person.

senses.en: the head of a government department
senses.pattern: the Secretary of State / the Education Secretary / the Health Secretary
senses.example: The health [[secretary]] announced a national plan to hire five thousand more nurses for public hospitals.
senses.example_zh: 衛生部長宣布了一項全國性計畫，要為公立醫院增聘五千名護理師。

senses.en: the beginning or cause of a feeling or development
senses.pattern: the seeds of doubt / sow the seeds of / plant the seeds of
senses.example: The unfair decision sowed the [[seeds]] of distrust between the two neighboring villages.
senses.example_zh: 這項不公平的決定，成了兩個相鄰村莊互不信任的根源。

senses.en: a ranked player or team in a competition
senses.pattern: the top seed / the number one seed / the third seed
senses.example: The young player surprised everyone by beating the top [[seed]] in the first round.
senses.example_zh: 這名年輕選手在第一輪就擊敗頭號種子選手，令所有人大感意外。

senses.en: to cause someone or something to move or react suddenly
senses.pattern: send prices soaring / send sb into a panic / send sb flying / send sb to sleep
senses.example: The long drought [[sent]] vegetable prices soaring, and many families began growing their own greens.
senses.example_zh: 長期乾旱使菜價突然飆漲，許多家庭開始自己種菜。

senses.en: the punishment that a court gives to a criminal
senses.pattern: a prison sentence / a life sentence / serve a sentence / a light sentence
senses.example: The thief received a two-year prison [[sentence]] for breaking into several homes.
senses.example_zh: 這名竊賊因闖入多戶民宅，被判處兩年徒刑。

senses.en: to officially state a criminal's punishment in court
senses.pattern: be sentenced to five years / sentence someone to death / be sentenced to life in prison
senses.example: The judge [[sentenced]] the driver to six months in prison for causing the accident.
senses.example_zh: 法官判處肇事駕駛六個月有期徒刑。
senses.note: 常用被動 be sentenced to＋刑期

gsat.sentence: Tuck kills the man and is jailed and [[sentenced]] to be executed.

senses.en: to accept a responsibility or burden
senses.pattern: shoulder the responsibility / shoulder the burden / shoulder the cost
senses.example: After her father fell ill, she had to [[shoulder]] the responsibility of running the family shop.
senses.example_zh: 父親生病後，她必須承擔起經營家中店鋪的責任。

senses.en: the edge of a road outside the traffic lanes
senses.pattern: the hard shoulder / pull over onto the shoulder / drive on the shoulder
senses.example: When the engine started smoking, he pulled over onto the [[shoulder]] and called for help.
senses.example_zh: 引擎開始冒煙時，他把車停到路肩並打電話求救。

gsat.sentence: They may fill out an agreement spelling out who [[shoulders]] which responsibilities if a problem arises.

senses.en: sensible and able to be trusted
senses.pattern: sound advice / sound judgment / sound evidence / a sound investment
senses.example: A good scientist's conclusions must be based on [[sound]] evidence, not on personal feelings.
senses.example_zh: 優秀科學家的結論必須以可靠的證據為依據，而不是個人感受。

senses.en: in good condition; not damaged or ill
senses.pattern: structurally sound / safe and sound / of sound mind / a sound heart
senses.example: Engineers checked the bridge after the earthquake and declared it structurally [[sound]].
senses.example_zh: 地震過後，工程師檢查了這座橋，宣布其結構完好。

senses.en: to tolerate something; to survive it without being damaged
senses.pattern: stand the test of time / stand the heat / stand the strain / can't stand the noise
senses.example: These hiking boots are built to [[stand]] years of rough use on rocky mountain trails.
senses.example_zh: 這款登山靴做工紮實，經得起在多岩山徑上多年的嚴苛使用。
senses.note: 「忍受」義多用於否定句和疑問句

senses.en: an attitude or opinion that you state firmly
senses.pattern: take a stand on sth / make a stand against sth / a firm stand / a tough stand
senses.example: The city has taken a firm [[stand]] against littering, raising the fine to six thousand dollars.
senses.example_zh: 市政府對亂丟垃圾採取堅定的立場，把罰款提高到六千元。

senses.en: to remain valid, unchanged, or in force
senses.pattern: the offer still stands / the decision stands / the record still stands
senses.example: The judges watched the video again, but their original decision still [[stands]].
senses.example_zh: 裁判又看了一次影片，但他們原先的判定仍然有效。

gsat.sentence: Artwork created by truly great artists such as Picasso and Monet will no doubt [[stand]] the test of time.

senses.en: a series of similar things or events
senses.pattern: a string of / a string of hits / a string of accidents / a string of islands
senses.example: After a [[string]] of losses, the coach decided to change the team's training schedule completely.
senses.example_zh: 在一連串的敗仗之後，教練決定徹底改變球隊的訓練時程。

senses.en: special conditions attached to an offer or agreement
senses.pattern: no strings attached / with strings attached / come with strings
senses.example: The company offered free laptops to the school with no [[strings]] attached, which surprised everyone.
senses.example_zh: 這家公司免費提供筆電給學校，而且沒有任何附帶條件，讓大家都很驚訝。

senses.en: a room at home for reading and writing
senses.pattern: in the study / a quiet study / a book-lined study
senses.example: My father turned the spare bedroom into a [[study]] lined with shelves of history books.
senses.example_zh: 我父親把多出來的臥室改成書房，裡面擺滿了一排排歷史書。

senses.en: to look at something very carefully
senses.pattern: study sb's face / study the map / study the menu / study sth closely
senses.example: The detective [[studied]] the stranger's face for a moment, trying to remember where they had met.
senses.example_zh: 偵探仔細端詳那名陌生人的臉片刻，試著回想他們在哪裡見過。

senses.en: to measure how long something takes
senses.pattern: time a race / time sb / time how long / time yourself
senses.example: The coach [[timed]] each swimmer with a stopwatch and wrote the results on a whiteboard.
senses.example_zh: 教練用碼錶替每位泳者計時，並把成績寫在白板上。

senses.en: to arrange for something to happen at a particular moment
senses.pattern: be timed to coincide with / time sth well / badly timed / perfectly timed
senses.example: The concert was [[timed]] to end just before the last train left the station.
senses.example_zh: 音樂會的時間特意安排在末班車離站前結束。

senses.en: a period in history or in someone's life
senses.pattern: in ancient times / in modern times / hard times / keep up with the times
senses.example: In ancient [[times]], salt was so valuable that soldiers were sometimes paid with it.
senses.example_zh: 在古代，鹽非常珍貴，士兵的薪餉有時就是用鹽支付的。

gsat.sentence: Why is the spiral staircase popular in modern [[times]]?
In Victorian [[times]], cast iron spiral staircases were popular for public buildings and homes for the rich.

senses.en: used to emphasize the exact person or thing
senses.pattern: the very person / this very moment / the very same / the very thing
senses.example: This is the [[very]] book I have been looking for since the beginning of the semester.
senses.example_zh: 這正是我從學期初就一直在找的那本書。
senses.note: 只置於名詞前，常與 the/this/that 連用

senses.en: used to emphasize an extreme point in place or time
senses.pattern: the very top / the very end / the very beginning / the very back
senses.example: We climbed to the [[very]] top of the tower to watch the sun rise over the sea.
senses.example_zh: 我們爬到塔的最頂端，觀看太陽從海面升起。

senses.en: used with "have yet to" for something not done
senses.pattern: have yet to do / be yet to do / have yet to be decided
senses.example: The city has [[yet]] to announce when the new swimming pool will open to the public.
senses.example_zh: 市府尚未宣布新游泳池何時對外開放。
senses.note: have yet to V＝還沒…（不加 not）

senses.en: but; in spite of that
senses.pattern: simple yet effective / and yet / strange yet true
senses.example: The instructions looked simple, [[yet]] nobody in the class could finish the model in time.
senses.example_zh: 說明看起來很簡單，然而班上沒有人能及時完成模型。

senses.en: used to emphasize an increase or repetition
senses.pattern: yet another / yet again / yet more / worse yet
senses.example: The train was delayed [[yet]] again this morning, so half the class arrived late.
senses.example_zh: 今天早上火車又誤點了，所以班上有一半的人遲到。

gsat.sentence: But the culinary art of dim sum had [[yet]] to develop, for it was considered inappropriate to pair tea with food.
[[Yet]] listening well is a rare talent that everyone should treasure.

quiz.stem: Many people believe that wealthy countries should ______ a larger share of the burden of fighting climate change, since they have long been the biggest polluters.
quiz.explain_zh: shoulder＝承擔（責任）。富裕國家長期是最大污染源，應承擔更多對抗氣候變遷的責任。

quiz.stem: Whenever my mother needs to concentrate on her writing, she shuts herself in her ______, a small room upstairs filled with books and papers.
quiz.explain_zh: study＝書房。媽媽需要專心寫作時，就把自己關在樓上堆滿書和文件的書房裡。

quiz.stem: The cyclists were already exhausted, but the toughest ______ of the race, a steep climb to the mountain top, still lay ahead of them.
quiz.explain_zh: leg＝（比賽的）一段。最艱難的一段賽程是爬上山頂的陡坡，還在後頭。

quiz.stem: The student council launched a food ______ before the Lunar New Year and collected over a thousand cans for families in need.
quiz.explain_zh: drive＝（募集）活動。學生會在年前發起食物募集活動，募得上千個罐頭。

quiz.stem: Researchers have studied the rare disease for decades, but they have ______ to find a treatment that works for every patient.
quiz.explain_zh: yet＝尚未（have yet to）。研究人員至今還沒找到對所有病人都有效的療法。

quiz.stem: Arriving at the station two hours early, we had plenty of time to ______, so we played cards in a nearby café.
quiz.explain_zh: kill＝消磨（時間）。提早兩小時到車站，有很多時間要消磨，所以去打牌。

quiz.stem: Before putting all your savings into a new business, you should seek ______ financial advice from an expert rather than trust rumors online.
quiz.explain_zh: sound＝可靠的、明智的。創業投資前應向專家尋求可靠的理財建議。

quiz.stem: Thanks to the popular night market, the number of tourists visiting the old town reached a record ______ of two million last year.
quiz.explain_zh: high＝高點、最高水準。老城區的遊客人數去年創下兩百萬的歷史新高。

quiz.stem: Firefighters have not yet been able to ______ the cause of the explosion, but they suspect that a gas leak was responsible.
quiz.explain_zh: establish＝查明、證實。消防人員尚未查明爆炸原因，但懷疑是瓦斯外洩。

quiz.stem: The newly elected president will take ______ in January, and she has promised to make clean energy her top priority.
quiz.explain_zh: office＝公職；take office 就職。新當選的總統將於一月就職，並承諾優先發展潔淨能源。
